sections.heading: C — Vehicle Readiness: Maintenance, Seats, Mirrors
sections.markdown:
## C — Vehicle Readiness: Maintenance, Seats, Mirrors

FACT_ID: sec08-F01 | anchor: A01
Safe arrival starts before ignition with both driver and car ready; steady upkeep saves cash, aids emergencies, and follows the owner manual schedule [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec08-F02 | anchor: A01
Cars, trucks, and ATVs or UTVs need twin braking systems, foot plus parking brake, while motorcycles and mopeds need at least one [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec08-F03 | anchor: A01
Weak braking, noisy brakes, odd brake odor, or a pedal sinking to the floor all send you to a mechanic [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec08-F04 | anchor: A02
Verify signals, brake lights, taillights, and headlights by walking around outside the car [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F05 | anchor: A02
Every car, truck, and ATV or UTV carries two front headlights, left and right, plus at least one rear red lamp seen for 500 feet and a white lamp lighting the rear plate [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F06 | anchor: A02
Fitted turn signals must function, and signals are mandatory on all cars, trucks, and trailers wider than 40 inches [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F07 | anchor: A02
A crooked headlight wastes its beam and dazzles others, so night-vision trouble or constant oncoming flashes mean a mechanic should aim them [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F08 | anchor: A02
Wash headlight, backup, brake, and tail lenses, since grime can slash their output by 50 percent [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F09 | anchor: A02
Swap out cracked or broken glass that shatters easily and clouds sight, keep the windshield clean against sun and headlight glare, and top up washer fluid with antifreeze wash when frost threatens [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F10 | anchor: A02
Scrape snow, ice, and frost off every window, and keep the mandatory wipers wiping well with fresh blades when they streak [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F11 | anchor: A02
Iowa tint law lets the windshield and front side windows pass at least 70 percent of light, with no medical exemption granted [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F12 | anchor: A02
Guard a clear view by hanging nothing from the rearview mirror and pasting no decal clutter on the windshield [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F13 | anchor: A02
Worn, bald, or unbalanced tires stretch stopping distance, invite hydroplaning, wear faster, drink fuel, and fight steering and braking, while bouncing, wheel shake, or side-pull earns a mechanic visit [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F14 | anchor: A02
Inflate tires to spec, gauging pressure cold against the driver-door sticker or owner manual [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F15 | anchor: A02
Probe tread with a head-first penny; tread short of Lincoln crown top marks an unsafe tire due for replacement [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec08-F16 | anchor: A03
Steering gone stiff or slow to answer the wheel needs a mechanic inspection [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F17 | anchor: A03
Suspension steadies handling and comfort, so endless bouncing after bumps or stops signals worn shocks or parts [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F18 | anchor: A03
Exhaust pipes away poison gas, muffles noise, and cools hot fumes, yet a leak can kill swiftly, so never idle in a garage or sit in a running car with every window shut [A03].
Why it matters: odorless exhaust death is the reason for the absolute garage rule.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F19 | anchor: A03
A sour engine saps power, refuses starts, wastes fuel, fouls air, and may stall into traffic, so service it by the owner manual [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F20 | anchor: A03
The horn is a life-saving warner reserved strictly for warning others [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F21 | anchor: A03
Your inside mirror must reveal 200 feet astern; a load-blocked view demands an outside mirror, and vans must wear both outside mirrors [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F22 | anchor: A03
Dial in seat and mirrors for your own body before every drive, since fit governs control [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F23 | anchor: A03
Sit spine-flat with at least 10 inches of chest clearance from the wheel and the airbag aimed at your chest [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F24 | anchor: A03
Keep the wheel top at or below shoulder height, plant your heel to pivot between pedals, and let shorter drivers add a cushion or pedal extenders to hold the 10-inch gap [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F25 | anchor: A03
Float the head restraint level with the middle of your head [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F26 | anchor: A03
Sit tall and frame the whole rear window in the inside mirror, your chief rearward eye [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F27 | anchor: A03
Tip your head to the left window and set the left mirror to just glimpse the car flank, a sliver that vanishes once you sit straight [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec08-F28 | anchor: A03
Lean over the console and set the right mirror to just glimpse the right flank of the car [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0025]

Misconceptions: checking lights means walking around the car, not glancing from the seat; a dirty lens can halve light output; the penny test fails a tire when tread falls short of Lincoln crown.

Mnemonic: two brakes, two beams, one red rear; cold tires, penny tread; ten inches of chest, mirrors set before you roll.

Glossary: hydroplaning (tires skimming water instead of gripping); antifreeze wash (washer fluid that resists freezing); head restraint (the pad aligned to the head center); suspension (the shocks and parts steadying ride and control).

Dynamic facts: none in these pages; every maintenance, seating, and mirror rule above is stable handbook knowledge with no date-variable or place-variable values.
